sigla , ōrum, n. contr. from sigilla,
I.signs of abbreviation, abbreviations (late Lat.): “sigla in libris ponere, Just. Ep. ad Antecess. § 8: leges per siglorum obscuritates conscribere,” Cod. Just. 1, 17, 2, § 22 .
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
